mapper.select: with iv as ( select s.equip_id, coalesce(nr.state_cat, s.state_cat) as cat, floor(extract(epoch from least(coalesce(s.end_at, #{until}::timestamptz), #{until}::timestamptz) - greatest(s.start_at, #{from}::timestamptz)))::bigint as sec, (s.start_at >= #{from} and s.start_at < #{until}) as started from cms_equip_state_log s join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_note n on n.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and n.void_yn = 'N' left join cms_state_reason nr on nr.reason_id = n.reason_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.start_at < #{until} and (s.end_at is null or s.end_at > #{from}) ), st as ( select equip_id, sum(sec) as covered_sec, coalesce(sum(sec) filter (where cat = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) as unknown_sec, coalesce(sum(sec) filter (where cat = 'NST'), 0) as nst_sec, coalesce(sum(sec) filter (where cat = 'SDT'), 0) as sdt_sec, coalesce(sum(sec) filter (where cat = 'UDT'), 0) as udt_sec, coalesce(sum(sec) filter (where cat = 'PRD'), 0) as prd_sec, count(*) filter (where cat = 'UDT' and started) as failures from iv group by equip_id ), rs as ( select r.equip_id, sum(r.good_qty) as good_qty, sum(r.good_qty + r.scrap_qty + r.rework_qty + r.repair_qty) as total_qty, coalesce(sum(wp.std_ct_sec / wp.units_per_cycle * (r.good_qty + r.scrap_qty + r.rework_qty + r.repair_qty)), 0) as ideal_sec, coalesce(sum(wp.std_ct_sec / wp.units_per_cycle * r.good_qty), 0) as ideal_good_sec, count(*) filter (where wp.std_ct_sec is null) as ct_missing from prd_result r join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = r.wo_proc_id join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = r.equip_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and r.occurred_at >= #{from} and r.occurred_at < #{until} -- 원래 실적만, 되돌려진 것은 뺀다: 역분개 행은 설비가 비고 시각이 정정 시각이라 설비·기간 합에 안 잡힌다(MES D27 과 같은 규칙) and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result v where v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) group by r.equip_id ) select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, coalesce(st.covered_sec, 0) as covered_sec, coalesce(st.unknown_sec, 0) as unknown_sec, coalesce(st.nst_sec, 0) as nst_sec, coalesce(st.sdt_sec, 0) as sdt_sec, coalesce(st.udt_sec, 0) as udt_sec, coalesce(st.prd_sec, 0) as prd_sec, coalesce(st.failures, 0) as failures, coalesce(rs.ideal_sec, 0) as ideal_sec, coalesce(rs.ideal_good_sec, 0) as ideal_good_sec, coalesce(rs.ct_missing, 0) as ct_missing, coalesce(rs.good_qty, 0) as good_qty, coalesce(rs.total_qty, 0) as total_qty, pf.ideal_ct_sec from mst_equip e left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = e.node_id left join cms_equip_profile pf on pf.equip_id = e.equip_id left join st on st.equip_id = e.equip_id left join rs on rs.equip_id = e.equip_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and (e.use_yn = 'Y' or st.equip_id is not null or rs.equip_id is not null) and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\') order by h.node_cd nulls last, e.equip_cd limit 2001

select c.equip_id, coalesce(sum(c.qty + coalesce(v.qty, 0)) filter (where c.metric_cd = 'GOOD'), 0) as good_qty, coalesce(sum(c.qty + coalesce(v.qty, 0)) filter (where c.metric_cd = 'SCRAP'), 0) as scrap_qty from cms_equip_count c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id left join cms_equip_count v on v.reversal_of_id = c.count_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and c.reversal_of_id is null and c.occurred_at >= #{from} and c.occurred_at < #{until} group by c.equip_id

select c.equip_id, c.due_date, c.performed_at as done_at, c.due_usage, c.done_usage from cms_chk_run c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and c.mwo_id is null and c.status = 'DONE' and c.performed_at >= #{from} and c.performed_at < #{until} union all select m.equip_id, m.due_date, m.finished_at, null, null from cms_mwo m join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = m.equip_id where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and m.mwo_type = 'PM' and m.status in ('DONE', 'CLOSED') and m.due_date is not null and m.finished_at >= #{from} and m.finished_at < #{until}
